read.thesis: FY25 USG 3.5% with volume 1.5% and Q4 USG 4.2%, but 2026 guided to bottom of 4–6% range, with at least 2% volume and only a modest margin uplift from 20.0%.

triggers.label: 2026 USG at bottom of 4–6%
triggers.quote: 2026 growth is expected to be at the bottom end of the underlying sales growth range reflecting the slower market conditions.

triggers.label: Q4 price growth accelerating
triggers.quote: In the fourth quarter, underlying sales growth remained strong at 5.1%, with positive volumes and an acceleration in price growth.

triggers.label: Ice Cream demerger completed
triggers.quote: On 6 December 2025, Unilever completed the demerger of its Ice Cream business

triggers.label: Indonesia Q4 destocking base effect
triggers.quote: Fourth quarter growth was 17% due to our operational improvements and significant de-stocking in the prior year, which will not benefit future periods.

guidance.quote: We expect underlying sales growth for full year 2026 to be within our multi-year guidance range of 4% to 6%, with at least 2% underlying volume growth.
with at least 2% underlying volume growth
We anticipate a modest improvement in underlying operating margin for the full year versus 20.0% in 2025.
The remaining €130 million of savings will be delivered in 2026.

red_flags.label: Q4 growth moderating in developed markets
red_flags.quote: In the fourth quarter, underlying sales growth slowed to 1.7%, with 0.5% volume, reflecting slower market growth in both the US and Europe.

red_flags.label: Latin America volume declines
red_flags.quote: Latin America: 0.5% underlying sales growth, as pricing was largely offset by volume declines in challenging markets.
